services.name: Summer Pre-College Program
services.desc: Challenge yourself this summer, explore new ideas, and experience life at Colorado College. Colorado College’s Summer Pre-College Program invites rising juniors and seniors to join our community for a summer of exploration and discovery. In just two and a half weeks, you’ll dive deep into a single, for-credit course in environmental studies, history, economics and business, or human anatomy. You'll experience the fast-paced intensity of the Block Plan and outside the classroom, you’ll live on campus, explore the Rocky Mountains, and be supported by world-class faculty who are invested in your success. The application for Summer 2027 goes live in December. Earn College Credit Get a head

blurb: If you’re looking for a college that challenges the norm, stick around. At just over 2,000 students, class rosters here stay small on purpose-so you have the space to ask bolder questions, dig into complexity, and actually be heard while you’re doing it.
